title: No free option available
body:
Before committing to an annual plan, I’d like to try it for a month to see if I can make it a habit.  

- Offer a completely free plan (3‑5 habits).  
- If users want more habits or advanced features, they can upgrade to a premium plan.  

That way we can test the platform for a month; if it works, great-if not, no need to subscribe.
